title: campanula linifolia var. ruscinonensis
intro: Campanula linifolia var. ruscinonensis, commonly known as Ruskin's bellflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Ruskin's bellflower are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
